facts.text: L'AND Vineyards is a wine retreat about an hour's drive from Lisbon.
facts.excerpt: L’AND Vineyards is an exclusive wine retreat, just one hour drive from Lisbon

facts.text: The resort sits in a gently sloping, south-facing valley of vineyards in the Alentejo, overlooking the skyline of the medieval Montemor Castle.
facts.excerpt: Nested in the heart of the Alentejo, in a gently sloping south-facing valley of vineyardsoverlooking the skyline of the medieval Montemor Castle

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Promontorio and Marcio Kogan and houses an art collection including works by Michael Biberstein inspired by the sky.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Promontório and Márcio Kogan, the hotel houses an exclusive art collection, including works by Michael Biberstein inspired by representations of the sky

facts.text: Sky View suites let guests sleep under the Alentejo night sky through an opening bedroom ceiling, with decor in wood and natural stone.
facts.excerpt: Sky View suites, provide a unique experience of sleeping “under the starry sky of Alentejo”, through the opening of the bedroom ceiling.

facts.text: The Sky View Premium Suite has a private patio with a plunge pool and an outside fire pit.
facts.excerpt: One Bedroom Premium Suite with Sky View, private indoor patio with plunge pool, and outside fire pit.

facts.text: Land View Suites have a living room and a private patio with an outdoor fireplace, with views of gardens or patios.
facts.excerpt: With spacious living room, each suite features a private patio with an outdoor fireplace. Designed to achieve beauty through detail and balance, they open on to serene views of gardens or patios

facts.text: The Lake Villas have a private pool, interiors designed by L'AND and expansive outdoor living areas.
facts.excerpt: the newest villas with private pool have bespoke interior design by L’AND, expansive outdoor living areas and truly breathtaking views

facts.text: The Vinotherapie Spa by Vinoble Cosmetics is set in the vineyards and uses wine by-products such as grapes, seeds, skins, pulp and stems in its treatments.
facts.excerpt: The Vinoble spa treatments use wine by-products like grapes, seed, skins, pulp and stems to provide exceptional face and body rituals and massages that are completely unique.

facts.text: The spa interior was designed by Marcio Kogan and the spa has an indoor heated pool, sauna and hammam.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Marcio Kogan, the spa interior is a symphony of natural effects.

facts.text: The resort is surrounded by six hectares of organic vineyards of Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Alicante Bouschet, Syrah and Gouveio grapes.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by six hectares of vineyards, composed of Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Alicante Bouschet and Syrah red grapes varieties, and Gouveio white grape variety. The vineyard is organic

facts.text: Guests can create their own personalized wine in the winery, blending Alicante, Touriga Franca, Touriga Nacional and Syrah.
facts.excerpt: create your own personalized wine in our winery, using Alicante, Touriga Franca, Touriga Nacional and Syrah

facts.text: Guests can join stargazing experts with a powerful telescope; the Alentejo has a certified Dark Sky Reserve.
facts.excerpt: with a powerful telescope and professional guidance on hand, the sky’s the limit. Guests can join a team of stargazing experts/astronomers to spend a different evening watching the wonders the sky has to show.

facts.text: A one-hour hot-air balloon flight departs from the resort.
facts.excerpt: L’AND offers guests a one-hour flight, departing from L’AND Vineyards Resort.

facts.text: Horse rides go through the vineyards and olive groves with Montemor-o-Novo Castle as a backdrop.
facts.excerpt: gallop through the stunning sun-kissed vineyards, ride through groves of olive and trot around the L’AND residences  designed by renowned architects, all with the gorgeous backdrop of the Montemor-O-Novo Castle

facts.text: The resort is about 45 minutes from Lisbon's international airport, 4 km from Montemor-o-Novo and 20 minutes from Evora.
facts.excerpt: L’AND Vineyards is located about 45 minutes from Lisbon’s International airport, 4 km from Montemor-o-Novo and only 20 minutes from Évora

facts.text: MAPA restaurant reinterprets Portuguese cuisine through the lens of the Portuguese sea voyages, offering a new menu each season.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to MAPA. Here, we seek to celebrate and translate this wide gastronomic culture, born from our sea voyages, offering a new expedition each season.

facts.text: Cafe da Viagem is the wine bar, terrace and lake deck, with a view of the garden and the lake.
facts.excerpt: With an outstanding view to the garden and the lake, contemporary fusion gastronomy, signature cocktails and a wine list representing the rich diversity of the region

facts.text: The outdoor swimming pool operates in spring and summer.
facts.excerpt: OUTDOOR SWIMMING POOL (SPRING/SUMMER)

facts.text: L'AND Vineyards opened in 2011 and is promoted by the family agro-business company Sousa Cunhal.
facts.excerpt: L’AND Vineyards was born in 2011.

facts.text: MAPA chef Miguel Laffan was recently awarded a Michelin star.
facts.excerpt: Chef **Miguel Laffan** takes the lead at MAPA, recently awarded a **_Michelin star_**.
